items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Dude politely gave him the seat, which when Basie started to playing, boy the house just turned around.

ctx.x: And there were about five of us playing in this place and we saw a guy come along, he looked like anything but a musician and oh boy, we were playing away you know and this guy -- I didn't know who he was and he came and stood right by the piano and looked, he kept looking

down at the piano and Dude would look up at him. Neither one of them said anything and finally between numbers Basie looked at Dude and said, "Man, you ain't playing nothing". He said, "Why don't you get on up" and Dude politely gave him the seat, which when Basie started to playing, boy the house just turned around. You know, he just shocked everybody in the house.
He was an accomplished piano player.
